0022600020.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-3, 10th in the East) visit the Miami Heat (1-4, 13th in the East) in Emirates NBA Cup East Group B play, with the Pacers on a two-game losing streak, 2-1 on the road, and 2 games back in the Central, while the Heat, 5th in the Southeast and 2 games back, have won their last game. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Miami is without Simone Fontecchio (illness). The two teams have not met yet this season, and the Pacers won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 135-118 win in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
